annotations.title: Every site's shops for one product

description: One product on every site that lists it, merged: the product (photos, versions, specifications), every shop's offer for one version in the locale's market across those sites (cheapest total first, out of stock last, each shop once, with the site that lists it, that site's product page and its shop link), the sites, and the lowest total per day over the last 90 days.

locale.description: Language and market (nl-NL = Dutch for the Netherlands, fr-BE = French for Belgium, de-DE = German for Germany, en-NL = English for the Netherlands; FR, DK and SE too). Shops, prices, currency and stock are per market; only sites that serve the locale answer. Default nl-NL.

product.description: The product's page URL on any site, or its id (from search_products).

version.description: A version id (colour, size, …); default: the version the product page selects.

name: compare_across_sites
